brief: Today's UPSC Intelligence Brief covering key developments across International Relations, Agriculture & Environment, Deep Sea Mining, Governance, and Critical Minerals.

articles.title: Cross-Border Electricity Trade Framework and South Asian Energy Security
articles.summary: India expands cross-border electricity trade rules to facilitate regional renewable energy integration across BBIN countries.
prelims: Governed by Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC) regulations in India.
BBIN initiative includes Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, and Nepal.
Facilitates tripartite energy agreements like the Nepal-India-Bangladesh power trade agreement.
articles.mains: Use as a concrete case study for Neighbourhood First Policy, regional diplomacy, and cross-border energy grid integration in South Asia.

articles.title: Implementation of National Climate Resilient Agriculture Framework
articles.summary: ICAR issues updated guidelines for scaling climate-smart agriculture technologies to combat erratic monsoon patterns.
prelims: National Innovations in Climate Resilient Agriculture (NICRA) was launched by ICAR in 2011.
Emphasizes heat-tolerant crop varieties, Direct Seeded Rice (DSR), and micro-irrigation systems.
Promotes carbon farming practices and Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs) for modern farm tools.
articles.mains: Useful for answers on agrarian distress, climate change adaptation strategies, and sustainable resource management in agriculture.

articles.title: Deep Sea Mining Code and Protection of Benthic Ecosystems
articles.summary: International Seabed Authority (ISA) reviews safety regulations for polymetallic nodule extraction in international waters.
prelims: ISA was established under the 1982 UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).
Polymetallic nodules are rich sources of nickel, cobalt, copper, and manganese.
India's Samudrayaan and Deep Ocean Mission are spearheaded by the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES).
articles.mains: Incorporate in questions regarding Blue Economy, environmental ethics vs. resource extraction, and ocean governance.

articles.title: Strengthening Digital Public Infrastructure for Rural Legal Inclusion
articles.source: PIB / Ministry of Law and Justice
articles.summary: Ministry of Law and Justice expands the Tele-Law initiative to streamline pre-litigation legal advice across rural Panchayats.
prelims: Tele-Law reaches rural populations using Common Services Centres (CSCs).
Operates under the DISHA (Designing Innovative Solutions for Holistic Access to Justice) scheme.
Complements NALSA's mandate to offer free legal services under Article 39A.
articles.mains: Highlight as an innovative application of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) to fulfill constitutional mandates on equal access to justice.

articles.title: National Critical Mineral Mission and Global Value Chain Integration
articles.summary: India advances key bilateral partnerships to secure processing capabilities and overseas supply chains for critical minerals.
prelims: Ministry of Mines identified 30 critical minerals essential for economic development and national security.
Khanij Bidesh India Ltd (KABIL) is a joint venture tasked with acquiring strategic mineral assets abroad.
India is a member of the US-led Mineral Security Partnership (MSP).
articles.mains: Crucial for questions on industrial strategy, green energy transition, geo-economics, and reducing strategic import dependencies.
